verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Daily exposing per-session packet loss, jitter, or bitrate through a dashboard or API. The only related item (daily-docs-27) says the global mesh network reduces packet loss and jitter, which is a network-performance claim, not a debugging metrics capability. The axis applies to a video SDK platform, so the lack of evidence makes this none rather than na.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, per-session quality metrics such as packet loss, jitter, and bitrate are available through a dashboard or API for debugging calls
